content.title: Codes, Ordinances & Resolutions in the City of Woodinville
content.summary: The City of Woodinville operates under the Woodinville Municipal Code (WMC), which contains the policies, fees, and standards guiding city operations. The City Council adopts ordinances and resolutions to regulate local affairs and update the municipal code as needed.

steps.title: Understand the Role of the City Council
steps.text: The City Council is the legislative body responsible for adopting ordinances, resolutions, rules, motions, and orders to regulate local affairs within the city limits.

steps.title: Refer to the Woodinville Municipal Code (WMC)
steps.text: The WMC contains the organized and categorized ordinances adopted by the City Council, which guide the city's policies, fees, and operating standards.

steps.title: Review Ordinances
steps.text: Ordinances are legal mechanisms used by the City Council to adopt or modify the municipal code. They can regulate conduct, prohibit actions, or be administrative in nature.

steps.title: Review Resolutions
steps.text: Resolutions are less formal than ordinances and generally express the opinion of the legislative body. They typically cover ministerial and administrative acts.

steps.title: Access Current Codes and Documents
steps.text: The City Clerk ensures that the municipal code and other regulatory documents are available online and kept current for public reference.
